verdicts.reason: The heavy base is built on untreated marsh and ordinary jobs finish without using branch routes. This matches branch_home's stated failure exactly.
Mud holds by weight, causes no injury and allows both self-release and companion extraction, as mud_escape requires.
The excavated trunk never changes and the borer extends no visible gallery. This is living_wood's stated failure.
Reach grows with pool size at matched distances, and large-pool encounter eligibility is checked separately rather than inferred from reach.
A real seizure creates a nonlethal timed obligation. Nearby carrying clears the deadline, and distant help arrives too late, which is permitted because it is not guaranteed.
One attack removes treasure service at every pool while danger at the attacked pool is unchanged. This is pool_memory's stated failure.
Crown sound ignores the living bird population and resumes while a second hush is still active.
The list is obtained through a supplied trader lane and shows an independent dated snapshot. Reading it leaves danger unchanged.
Ambient whole-body emergence must stay excluded and is reserved for plot material. Limbs and the eye do not license a routine ambient whole body.
Disabling the feature mid-transit returns the treatment intact, and the defeated adult makes no shared Tenant strikes.
The tank teaches despite failed placement, and a fatal hit silently deletes the captive. Both are captive_economy's stated failures.
Establishment lasts several days and is unaffected by poisoning another pool. The right poison at the young's own pool stops it, and the adult does not revive immediately.
A repeated display release pays the reward twice, which is return_bargain's stated failure.
Normal bait work produces a delayed raid from separate edges. Raiders keep converging on the available bait after their first actions.
The rooms are navigable, but the alarm never changes the retreat route, which living_hive's altered-retreat requirement forbids.
Home-water drinking is correct, but the ambusher pursues escaping prey across the map. This violates the ambush contract in native_life.
A real harvest pays out and a real spark flashes eligible haze, while the permanently defeated adult stays inactive.
Theft and raid-back must stay absent, yet a normal lure raid steals a colonist and carries them off.
Reload cancels the active rescue deadline, so the victim can never be lost. This is ordinary_walk's stated failure and breaks the timed rescue obligation.
Only the right poison at the young's own pool A may stop maturity. Poisoning disconnected pool B must not stop A's countdown.
Reading the list raises actual agitation and strike chance at the reader's pool. The intel must report a snapshot without editing danger.
Ambience and calls resume while the sentinel hush reason is still active. Neither may resume until all hush reasons end.
Disabling the feature in transit consumed the charges. Disabled treatment must be returned.
The second front enters beside the first even though a separate reachable approach exists. This is bait_wager's stated failure.
Grievance must belong only to pool A and raise A's danger. Here service stops at both pools and A's hostility is unchanged.
Weight-scaled trapping holds without injury and allows self-release. A lighter traveller passing freely is consistent with weight scaling.
